title: Do you feel safe with your robot? Factors Influencing Perceived Safety in Human-Robot Interaction based on Subjective and Objective Measures
reasoning: The paper's entire focus is on 'perceived safety' in human-robot interaction. Safety is a fundamental ethical consideration in the design and deployment of autonomous systems. The paper conducts a deep, empirical investigation into the subjective factors (like trust, comfort, sense of control) that constitute this ethical concept, making it a core component of the research, rather than a brief or passing mention.
